components.title: compliant-s3
components.description: Terraform primitive for an AWS S3 primary bucket plus a dedicated access-log bucket. Hardcodes server-side encryption, versioning, public access block, access logging, and required compliance tags. Maps to CGE-P Lab 2.3 at terraform/primitives/compliant-s3.
components.purpose: Provide a compliant-by-default S3 primitive that any team can adopt with a small consumer Terraform file.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by this module.

implemented-requirements.description: AES-256 server-side encryption is enforced via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration on both the primary and access-log buckets. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override.

links.text: Lab 4.4 Cosign-signed pipeline bundle (run 34522029255). plan.json records the encryption configuration.

implemented-requirements.description: Public access is blocked on both buckets via aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block. All four flags (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets) are true. The module does not expose these flags as variables.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle. plan.json contains the four-true public access block.

implemented-requirements.description: Access logs from the primary bucket are routed to a dedicated log bucket via aws_s3_bucket_logging. The log bucket carries its own encryption and public access block.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle. plan.json contains aws_s3_bucket_logging routing primary access logs to the log bucket.

implemented-requirements.description: Four required compliance tags (Project, Environment, ManagedBy, ComplianceScope) are applied via the AWS provider default_tags block. Variable validation rejects environments outside dev/staging/prod and project names outside the regex. Object versioning is enabled on the primary bucket.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle. Conftest output and plan.json verify tags_all and versioning.
